layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/gb/halifax/default.json (same 9 columns as Lloyds, d/m/Y, header row)
https://github.com/BWeesy/gubbins/blob/main/statementflow/profiles/halifax.yaml (Lloyds Banking Group, same export layout as Lloyds; newest first)
https://github.com/Metasaura/ofxstatement-lloyds/blob/main/tests/sample-statement.csv (the shared Lloyds Banking Group row shape)
notes: Lloyds Banking Group layout: newest first, DD/MM/YYYY, header with a trailing comma, sort code with a leading apostrophe, Debit Amount / Credit Amount positive, running Balance, no thousands mark, no currency. Type codes DD, DEB, CPT (cash), BGC, SO, FPI. LF line endings assumed as for Lloyds. ASCII.
